blockingIssues.description: internal/channels/dashboard/decisions_api.go uses bufio.Scanner with default token limit; large audit JSONL lines can trigger token-too-long and cause GET /api/admin/runs/{id}/decisions to return 500.

internal/channels/dashboard/ui/src/pages/DelegationPage.tsx parseDelegationMode only accepts new modes and falls back to suggest_only, which can misrepresent and overwrite backend-valid legacy modes like tool_gated/prompt_only/auto_execute.

appliedUpdates.description: Updated .factory/library/architecture.md to reflect dashboard API handler split across multiple files (including decisions_api.go), replacing stale single-file claim.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Tighten skill-procedure compliance reporting: when required manual/integration checks (e.g., interactiveChecks) are omitted, workers should not mark followedProcedure=true, or skills should explicitly define acceptable non-interactive alternatives.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Observed in typed-roles-api-ui and decision-ledger reviews: handoffs omitted interactiveChecks despite skill steps requiring them.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify backend-worker tests-first guidance as strict vs best-effort for large/interrupted refactors to reduce inconsistent reviewer interpretation.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: delegation-planner review observed implementation patches before first focused red-phase test while still producing passing coverage.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Align delegation failure-retry semantics across mission artifacts so contract and feature specs do not diverge (same-role retry vs different-role retry).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: validation-contract.md states different-role retry while delegation-planner feature spec and implementation/tests use same-role retry.
